verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly state support for 1.5-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit, and 8-bit integer quantization for reduced memory use, covering the full very-low-bit to 8-bit range. Community reports corroborate real-world memory savings (Q6_K near-FP16 perplexity at much smaller size, 70B models runnable on desktop RAM) validating the practical benefit. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark table quantifying exact memory reduction per bit-width or independent third-party quantization accuracy study beyond community anecdotes.
